concepts.title: A  Interlock
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. New original logo design for "GentlePath", a compassionate, confident app and website for families navigating autism. The explicit creative direction is PUZZLE PIECES combined intelligently with the letters G and P. Make the jigsaw connection recognizable: a rounded protruding tab with a short neck and a matching concave socket. Do not substitute generic blobs, infinity loops, hearts, leaves, or decorative abstract marks. The puzzle form and letterforms should become ONE considered brand symbol, designed by a senior identity designer.
Mood: bold, warm, modern, memorable, approachable, premium. Clean, mathematically deliberate outlines and confident visual weight. Original distinctive silhouette, excellent positive/negative space. Clearly legible G and P where the concept calls for letters. A capital P must have an upper bowl and a lower stem with OPEN SPACE to the lower right; never accidentally make it a D.
Presentation: one wide landscape identity proof, about 3:2. Warm plain ivory canvas #FFFDF8, perfectly clean flat digital color, no paper texture or lighting. Show the EXACT SAME designed symbol THREE times: left, centered inside a rounded-square app tile; middle, as a large standalone symbol; right, next to the exact wordmark "GentlePath" on a single horizontal line. The wordmark area takes half the canvas. Consistent geometry in all three versions; only color inversion allowed for the app tile. Generous clear margins. Small simple title at top left as specified. Three understated labels under the samples: "App Icon", "Symbol", "Icon + Text". No other text, no tagline, no mockup.
Typography: bespoke-looking contemporary humanist sans for the wordmark, strong optical kerning, warm curves and deliberate details; not timid, thin, or overly cute. Exact spelling "GentlePath", capital G and P, no space. The GP symbol is custom logo drawing, not ordinary letters typed in a font.
Production look: crisp vector-like filled artwork, flat 1–3 colors, readable at small icon sizes, no shadows, no gradients, no bevels, no 3D, no watercolor, no fuzzy edges, no construction grid, no micro-details, no device mockups, no extraneous icons, no copied existing logos, no watermark. Puzzle pieces are a central requirement, not a tiny decorative accent.
Title (verbatim): "A  Interlock".
Specific design: Two bold chunky CUSTOM LETTERFORMS: a rounded capital G on the left, a capital P on the right. They interlock through one unmistakable jigsaw tab-and-socket at their central join. Forest G and lavender P. Let the G's horizontal inner arm become the puzzle tab that plugs into the P's vertical stem. Both letters remain readable, compact almost-square combined silhouette; gently offset vertically to create rhythm. The P's bottom-right quadrant is open. No enclosing puzzle-piece badge around the monogram: the letters themselves are the two connecting puzzle pieces.
Palette and applications: Forest #174E46, warm lavender #A99AC8, ivory #FFFDF8. Forest app tile with ivory G and lavender P.
